question.wording: Is this item the same payment a form already on this sheet reports on the same line (a Form W-2, 1099, 1098, 1098-C, SSA-1099, a Form 1040-ES voucher, or the settlement statement) — so counting it would count the payment twice?

options.label: Yes — the same payment, already counted
No — a payment no other form reports
